cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Part identity
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Confirm manufacturer, exact order number, family, lifecycle state, and downloaded file identity agree.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Manufacturer product page or datasheet plus recorded order number

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Datasheet provenance
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Store the official datasheet, source URL, revision or publication date, and SHA-256 checksum.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Local datasheet file, source URL, and checksum

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: CAD geometry and units
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Open the 3D model, verify units and overall dimensions against the official dimensional drawing, and check for corrupt or excessive geometry.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Dimension comparison and rendered CAD preview

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Mounting and clearance
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Verify mounting method, insertion point, orientation, panel cutout or DIN-rail engagement, and required service/thermal clearance envelope.

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Terminal and port map
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Match every schematic pin and 3D connection port to an official terminal designation, function, electrical type, and stable catalog terminal key.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Official connection diagram and terminal-map comparison

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: IEC schematic symbol
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Validate the IEC symbol geometry, intelligent pins, default tag family, orientation, and parent/child cross-references.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Rendered IEC symbol and pin-list comparison

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: NFPA/JIC schematic symbol
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Validate the NFPA/JIC symbol geometry, intelligent pins, default tag family, orientation, and parent/child cross-references.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Rendered NFPA/JIC symbol and pin-list comparison

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Electrical ratings
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Verify voltage, current, power, frequency, utilization category, interrupting/SCCR data, and environmental ratings applicable to the selected part.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Datasheet rating table and normalized equipment properties

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Cables workbench integration
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Create or connect the physical route through the FreeCAD Cables workbench and confirm route length and endpoints return to the canonical CE wire or cable record.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Cables route object link, endpoint identities, and calculated length

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Safety evidence
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Verify safety approvals and intended architecture attributes against the risk assessment; do not infer PL, SIL, category, or diagnostic coverage from geometry.

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Software and I/O mapping
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Confirm channel or device labels, addresses, data type, scaling, and terminal identities map consistently to the I/O and wiring schedules.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: I/O schedule row and matching terminal/channel records

cedoc:TestDefinition.title: Termination treatment
cedoc:TestDefinition.instruction: Verify conductor range, strip length, ferrule or listed lug, crimp tool/profile, and terminal compatibility; reject bare stranded-wire terminations.
cedoc:TestDefinition.requiredEvidence: Terminal instructions and termination inspection record
